mainEntity.name: How do tiny homes compare to traditional apartments as rental units?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiny homes, especially ADUs, offer several advantages over traditional apartments as rental units. They provide tenants with greater privacy, often a small outdoor space, and a unique living experience. For owners, tiny homes can generate higher per-square-foot rental income and add significant property value without the complexities of multi-unit apartment management. They also offer flexibility for housing family or caregivers. Zen Tiny Homes specializes in creating high-quality, standalone rental units tailored to your property and local regulations.
